title: What is Codemode
thesis: Bash/CLIs belong in the target execution environment ('the hands'), while Codemode (sandboxed Wasm JS) orchestrates the trusted harness ('the brain') without flooding LLM context.
key_takeaways: Split trusted harness ('brain') from sandboxed execution env ('hands');Compose bulk tool calls & Jev classifiers in QuickJS/Wasm and return distilled summaries;Use progressive MCP tool search instead of upfront schema bloat;Return consistent JSON shapes across batch sizes and avoid nested 'Codemode in Codemode'
